description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Indeed is hiring a Software Engineer I to help design and develop shared infrastructure and services used across the company. The role develops reliable, scalable features and tools, collaborates with engineers and cross-functional partners, participates in code reviews, and supports ongoing technical learning and experimentation.
Software Engineer I developing, testing, and maintaining features for shared services and tools

Responsibilities:
• Develop, test, and maintain features for a suite of shared services and tools
• Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners to deliver well-designed solutions
• Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality and maintainability
• Learn and apply new technologies, tools, and best practices in software engineering

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related field
• Familiarity with AWS, Java, Kotlin, and/or React.js
• Passion to learn and develop new skills continuously
